title: A new laser
desc: J: "we absolutely need a better laser than the one that shoots right now". Core + one camera-facing glow quad + haze + flares, fast (2 ticks to the wall).

takes.facts: thin core, streak glow flowing to the target, haze, flares at ring and hit

takes.name: construct lance
takes.facts: core, your hex construct texture flowing on the glow, haze, flares

takes.name: pulse lance
takes.facts: core, bright bands racing to the target, O4's two spinning rims, sparks at the hit

takes.name: charged
takes.facts: L1 wider and hotter, three shock rings slide down the beam, sparks, scorch
